HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP — MOCK EXAM #19
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nakuru
   B. Nairobi
   C. Kisumu
   D. Mombasa

2. Which statement about Colonization of Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Colonization of Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Colonization of Africa never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Colonization of Africa as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Colonization of Africa.

3. Which statement about African Civilisations up to 19th Century is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say African Civilisations up to 19th Century never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain African Civilisations up to 19th Century with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing African Civilisations up to 19th Century.
   D. Treat African Civilisations up to 19th Century as rumours only.

4. Which statement about Modern Nationalism in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Modern Nationalism in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Modern Nationalism in Africa.
   C. Explain Modern Nationalism in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Modern Nationalism in Africa as rumours only.

5. Which statement about Linguistic groups in Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Linguistic groups in Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Linguistic groups in Kenya.
   C. Treat Linguistic groups in Kenya as rumours only.
   D. Say Linguistic groups in Kenya never happens in Kenya.

6. Which statement about Elections in Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Elections in Kenya as rumours only.
   B. Say Elections in Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Elections in Kenya.
   D. Explain Elections in Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

7. Which statement about Human Developments in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Human Developments in Africa.
   B. Explain Human Developments in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Human Developments in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Human Developments in Africa as rumours only.

8. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Hide all money underground
   B. Avoid saving forever
   C. Ignore prices in shops
   D. Plan income and spending wisely

9. Which statement about National integration is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain National integration with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat National integration as rumours only.
   C. Say National integration never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing National integration.

10. Which statement about Public Participation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Public Participation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Public Participation never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Public Participation.
   D. Treat Public Participation as rumours only.

11. Which statement about Global Wars is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Global Wars.
   B. Say Global Wars never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Global Wars as rumours only.
   D. Explain Global Wars with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. Which statement about Establishment of colonial rule is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Establishment of colonial rule never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Establishment of colonial rule with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Establishment of colonial rule.
   D. Treat Establishment of colonial rule as rumours only.

13. Which statement about Introduction to History and Citizenship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Introduction to History and Citizenship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Introduction to History and Citizenship never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Introduction to History and Citizenship.
   D. Treat Introduction to History and Citizenship as rumours only.

14. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Littering in markets
   B. Avoiding all community work
   C. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   D. Destroying road signs

15. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Measure rainfall only
   B. Explain symbols used on a map
   C. Name the president
   D. Replace the compass rose

16. Which statement about Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence as rumours only.
   C. Explain Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain National integration and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Human Developments in Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain African Civilisations up to 19th Century and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Colonization of Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Modern Nationalism in Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Global Wars and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain American Revolution and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain International organisations and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
